description: Close the aggregate delivered-source evidence package (#668; REQ-039; AC-R039-01, AC-R039-02, AC-R039-03, AC-GAL-01..08). Explicit non-gallery disposition (accepted gallery reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d; REQ-039 coverage entry). Aggregate proof closure only: no product code, no new shared checker, no re-run of any earlier check. check-01 consumes TASK-039’s providers and every owner’s committed task-local receipts: it invokes the shared checker scripts/refinement/verify-delivery-evidence.mjs in final mode over every delivery task (all approved tasks except the setup-only TASK-039, which final mode refuses, and this task), verifies each criterion’s approved verification checks with verifyReceipt, and reads the accepted-gallery reference (coverage map revision 6, REUSE.md, LOGGING-FIELDS.md, tokens.css, FINAL-POLISH-ACCEPTANCE.md) byte for byte from the out-of-Git store and the approved requirements handoff (APPROVED_HANDOFF.json sha256 a8e1b591ca85da3f961a21a06dc0ace5fb37520652c8495ec95fb2a3c71c9397, requirements set 93cf163b…) from the Runner V2 project layout; both fail closed when absent. It owns evidence/refinement/task-042/source-map.json, the final criterion -> journey -> completion owner -> real route -> gallery state -> shared owner -> executed case map (32 journeys, 202 criteria, 26 accepted states, 16 logging contexts, four skins, P01-P05), which a case re-derives from the authorities and requires to be identical. Definition records TASK-035/037/038 close by their current receipts and by verifying every repo: source at each record’s delivered commit (later approved tasks edited some repo: files; the records and their approvals are not edited). AC-R039-02 also closes by evidence/refinement/task-042/delivered-captures.json, a committed hash-only manifest of the delivered-revision actual-app captures and measurement attachments (TASK-002/007/008/012/013/014/033/041 approved guard commands re-run unchanged at the recorded revision, every receipt rewritten byte-identical), each paired with its staged V/P before reference or an explicit stand-in; the bytes live outside Git, content-addressed at <store>/clear-refinement-20261103/task-042/objects/<sha256> in the README's evidence store, and the case re-hashes every object. Backend-lane receipts of TASK-047 and TASK-048 are consumed as committed, never re-run. Every declared case must execute and pass.
